title: Ping a host with timestamped replies
summary: Ping a host and display the exact time each reply packet was received. This helps in analyzing latency patterns over time.

steps.explain: Send ICMP echo requests to the host and print the time each packet was received.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The domain name or IP address of the host.

steps.expect: The terminal displays responses with a timestamp for each reply. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
